stories.title: Seoul court orders N. Korea to pay W44.6b for blowing up inter-Korean liaison office

en.title: Seoul court orders N. Korea to pay W44.6b for blowing up inter-Korean liaison office
en.summary: A Seoul court ruled that North Korea must pay South Korea over 44.6 billion won for demolishing the inter-Korean joint liaison office in Kaesong in June 2020. This marks the South Korean government's first legal victory against North Korea in a damages suit, though enforcement mechanisms remain unclear.

stories.title: Ex-President Yoon Acquitted of Perjury in Appeals Trial

en.title: Ex-President Yoon Acquitted of Perjury in Appeals Trial
en.summary: Former President Yoon Suk Yeol was acquitted of perjury charges in an appellate ruling. The Seoul High Court upheld a lower court decision finding him not guilty of providing false testimony during former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo's insurrection trial.

stories.title: Land minister nominee vows faster housing supply amid rising home prices

en.title: Land minister nominee vows faster housing supply amid rising home prices
en.summary: The nominee for land, infrastructure and transport minister pledged to mobilize public and private sector resources to accelerate housing supply and stabilize the market.
